comparison.objective: Hold a sprung M.2 drive flat while turning a latch over its end; candidate adjusts a screw, locks it with a jam nut, and cycles the gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual suppression of spring lift plus quarter-turn latch actuation versus two concentric tools applying opposed torque to coupled threaded parts.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the drive within 2.5° of flat, latch turned at least 70°, and hands 30 mm clear; candidate additionally requires a precise 90° stop retained across three motion cycles with at most 2° drift.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record in simultaneous hold-and-lock structure, but it tests holding a separate sprung component while closing a latch, not counterholding an adjustable screw during jam-nut tightening.
